dedupe_keys.name: bsee and boem outer continental shelf oil and gas platforms 7 317 structures with install and removal dates and well surface locations gulf pacific alaska gis layers

description: BSEE and BOEM publish the offshore oil and gas structures and wells on the U.S. Outer Continental Shelf as mapping files, listed as National Geospatial Data Assets on GeoPlatform.gov and data.gov (NGDA 158 for Gulf platforms; 53, 54 and 55 for wells in the Alaska, Gulf and Pacific regions). Contents: the BSEE platform shapefile has 7,317 platform and structure points with structure number, complex identifier, structure name, installation date and removal date, so both active and decommissioned structures are included; the BOEM well layers give well surface locations by region; BSEE's data centre adds online queries for platform structures with incident counts and production by platform. Producer: BSEE (platforms, from the Technical Information Management System) and BOEM (wells). Coverage: federal waters of the Gulf of America, Pacific and Alaska OCS regions. Format and access: shapefile and file geodatabase downloads from data.bsee.gov (platform file last modified 1 September 2026), and CSV, GeoJSON, GeoPackage and geodatabase downloads for wells from the BOEM ArcGIS Hub; no registration. Licence: U.S. public domain. Caveats: the files are marked approximate and not an official record; the Gulf well layer on data.gov states locations as of March 2015; coordinates are NAD 27 for the Gulf. Simulation uses: hurricane and metocean exposure of offshore production assets, decommissioning scenario planning, and linking platforms to the pipeline network for supply disruption studies. Related records: the NPC 1995 pipeline networks (data-npc-pipeline-networks-1995-ntad) are an older national pipeline layer.
